subject: Pre-contract security & PO intake — RiverMed onboarding
messages:
From: Aditi Shah <aditi.shah@rivermed.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@rivermed.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: RiverMed onboarding — kickoff & docs

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. RiverMed is excited to move forward — attached are a few baseline items to get the procurement queue started. Please find the following:

- RiverMed_W9.pdf (filled)
- RiverMed_SOC2_Summary_2025.pdf (redacted executive summary; full report available under NDA)
- PenTest_Attestation_2026.pdf (letter from our security vendor)

A couple notes: our ISO 27001 certificate is currently under renewal and should be available in ~2 weeks; we'll share once the certs come back. Also, we redacted customer-specific data from the SOC 2 summary; happy to provide the full SOC2 type II under a standard NDA.

Can you confirm the PO path (contact in finance, acceptable invoice remit details) and if you need anything else for pre-contract security acceptance? Our preferred billing entity and address are in the W-9.

Thanks,
Aditi Shah
Head of Procurement
RiverMed Analytics
attachments: RiverMed_W9.pdf, RiverMed_SOC2_Summary_2025.pdf, PenTest_Attestation_2026.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Aditi Shah <aditi.shah@rivermed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-29T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RiverMed onboarding — kickoff & docs

Aditi — really appreciate the prompt turnaround and the attachments. Quick checklist & next steps from our side: 

1) Security evidence received: W-9, SOC2 summary, pen test attestation — thank you. Please confirm whether the full SOC2 Type II report requires an NDA (we can sign a mutual NDA; CC'd Connor for that).

2) ISO27001: noted it's pending. If it comes through within 2 weeks that should be fine; if not, we'll document the expected delivery date in the procurement ticket.

3) PO & invoicing: our finance team prefers a standard PO; Marissa — can you confirm the contact for issuing the PO and whether RiverMed needs a vendor portal invite?

4) Contract/legal: we'll need the primary contact for commercial/legal redlines (name + email) so our Legal can loop in any standard terms exceptions.

Target timeline: we usually aim to have security intake and PO queued within 7-10 business days after we have the SOC2/pen test artifacts and W-9. If RiverMed needs the service start date sooner, let us know and we can evaluate early-access provisioning with an initial purchase order.

I'll open a HubSpot procurement ticket and attach these documents (link below). Connor — can you generate the NDA template if requested?

HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/rivermed (I will attach the files there).

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124
From: Aditi Shah <aditi.shah@rivermed.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@rivermed.com>, James Conway <james.conway@rivermed.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RiverMed onboarding — kickoff & docs

Thanks Karthik — quick clarifications inline and attaching originals for reference.

- NDA: RiverMed is happy to sign a mutual NDA; our legal contact is James Conway (james.conway@rivermed.com).
- SOC2: the full Type II report is available to partner security teams under NDA; the attached summary should suffice for initial procurement gating.
- ISO: we will upload the renewed certificate to the portal once we receive it (ETA 11/11/2026).
- PO: our procurement team prefers to receive the PO via email to procurement@rivermed.com; remit to address matches the W-9.

Attachment stubs: RiverMed_W9.pdf (official), RiverMed_SOC2_Summary_2025.pdf, PenTest_Attestation_2026.pdf

Forwarding James for NDA and legal details.

Best,
Aditi
---
Aditi Shah
Head of Procurement | RiverMed Analytics
aditi.shah@rivermed.com | +1 (617) 555-0890
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement <procurement@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditi Shah <aditi.shah@rivermed.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: RiverMed onboarding — kickoff & docs

FYI — routing this to finance/procurement to start a PO ticket. Key items to capture:

- Vendor: RiverMed Analytics (W-9 attached in thread)
- Deal: RWI-2026-1180 (HubSpot link below)
- Required security checklist items received: SOC2 summary, pen test attestation. Full SOC2 report pending NDA. ISO certificate expected 11/11/2026.
- Billing & remit: details as per attached W-9; procurement@rivermed.com is the PO recipient.

Action items for finance:
- Open PO request and confirm expected PO number and estimated send date.
- If procurement requires a vendor portal invite, let me know and I'll coordinate with RiverMed.

HubSpot Deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/RWI-2026-1180
DocuSign (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/abcdef1234567890

Thanks — cc'ing Marissa to keep commercial in the loop.

-Karthik
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditi Shah <aditi.shah@rivermed.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-30T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RiverMed onboarding — kickoff & docs

Aditi — thanks for sending these over. Finance has confirmed they can open a PO once we have the W-9 and pen-test attestation (both received). We've provisionally approved a start date of 2026-11-15 pending the ISO cert (if ISO isn't available by then we'll document the exception).

Next steps for RiverMed:
- Please send James Conway (legal) the NDA (we'll countersign) or reply to Connor directly to expedite.
- When ISO is posted, add to the HubSpot attachments or reply here and we'll grab it.
- Expect PO number within 3 business days after finance finalizes (we'll email the PO to procurement@rivermed.com).

Small note: we've agreed to a one-time early-access credit to align kickoff timelines; final amount will be in the PO.

Appreciate the collaboration — looking forward to getting RiverMed onto Dedicated capacity.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0233
